svg.title: Known-best packing of 228 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=228 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the free grid slack closed and the near-axis squares straightened at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-18 rational centre-basis Witness/v2 at 228, the source's exact conversion of jazivxt's public Kaggle decimal packing under one uniform clearance dilation, read exactly from the retained source file. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
